layers.message: Add login command with local credential store
Promote credential persistence cycle to standard
Record project context for credential persistence

graderOnly: The tentative expedited code (ledgerctl/credstore.py, a SQLite database credentials.sqlite3 in the config directory keyed by base_url, plus the login subcommand and stored-token fallback in ledgerctl/cli.py) chose a new persistence pattern that is not established by project context or scope.

The pre-cycle baseline keeps local state only as JSON in the config directory, written by save_config through tempfile.mkstemp plus os.replace, which yields files with mode 0600; the baseline has no sqlite3 usage and stores no credentials.
The tentative SQLite store does not restrict file permissions (the database is created with the default umask), there is no logout, and no tests cover login or stored tokens.

No specific persistence design is mandated. A design may still choose SQLite, but only with rationale grounded in the scope and established constraints, not because the tentative code exists; the design should say how the tentative code is to be reconciled (kept, changed, or replaced).
Project context in .standards/CONTEXT.md is valid for the active cycle, so a normal brownfield handoff to DEVELOPING is expected.

all.why: PromotionReason is durable for the rest of the cycle
Architect does not edit Auditor-owned context
scope and context are inputs Architect must not rewrite
no project design document exists, so the design is created with artifact init at the fixed path
Architect reconciles code in the design; it does not edit code

invariants.why: roles suggest commits but do not make them unless asked
roles do not change git state unless asked
the turn-end check finds no new problem
Architect writes no production code, tests, or user documentation

selfChecks.why: the established test command passes on the built tree with the tentative code present (12 tests, as the context and plan record)

selfChecks.cmd: [ $(git log --format=%s -- ledgerctl/credstore.py | wc -l) -eq 1 ] && git log --format=%s -- ledgerctl/credstore.py | grep -qx 'Add login command with local credential store'
selfChecks.why: the SQLite credential store exists only from the expedited cycle commit

selfChecks.cmd: ! git grep -q sqlite3 $(git rev-list --max-parents=0 HEAD) -- ledgerctl
selfChecks.why: the pre-cycle baseline has no SQLite persistence
the tentative login subcommand is present in the working tree

notes: Standalone brownfield fixture. 00-project (pre-install): stdlib-only Python CLI ledgerctl with JSON config.json written atomically via mkstemp+os.replace, token only from --token or LEDGERCTL_TOKEN, 12 pytest tests run with python3 -m pytest -q. 50-expedited: first cycle started EXPEDITED in DEVELOPING with an approved plan (Acceptance EXPEDITED_REQUEST). 51-login: tentative implementation adds ledgerctl/credstore.py (SQLite credentials.sqlite3 keyed by base_url) and a login subcommand plus stored-token fallback in cli.py; plan marks DEV-001 DONE with self-check evidence. 52-promote: STATE promoted to STANDARD/AUDITING with Handoff PROMOTE and Active Work.PromotionReason naming the consequential persistence decision; plan gets a Plan Notes pause entry. 53-context: Auditor CONTEXT.md describing the pre-cycle baseline and an Active-Cycle Non-Baseline Work section with entries labeled Cycle: credential-persistence-20260925T090000Z-2b3c4d5e (uses COMMIT substitutions); STATE to SCOPING. 54-scope: completed scope AC-001..AC-007, implementation-agnostic; STATE to ARCHITECTING, FORWARD from SCOPING, Architecture NONE, recovery inactive. Commit date set to 2026-09-26 so the cycle id timestamp (2026-09-25) precedes the commits. Utterance is the catalog's Continue.; the case prompt's instruction about not treating tentative code as a constraint is left out. Project docs and records use python3 because the runner image has no python command.
